$description: Design tokens generated from a full Variables export of the Figma DS file '4m8yv2o7usGlI32Y1hmxSH' (collections: Primitives, Semantic/Light, Semantic/Dark, Component, Component Sizes/small|medium|large, Semantic Grid/Desktop|Tablet|Mobile), uploaded by the user on 2026-08-25. Every color/dimension below is a real value from that export, aliased wherever an exact match to a primitive or semantic token was found. Two deliberate corrections vs. the raw export: (1) color.base.transparent / color.gray.transparent were restored to #ffffff00 — the CSV export dropped the alpha channel; the earlier Figma API read (get_variable_defs on the 'buttons' frame) confirmed #ffffff00. (2) the 'infirmation' variable group (a typo in the Figma file) is exposed here as 'information' — fix the spelling in Figma too if you want the names to match 1:1. Component tokens alias semantic tokens via their Light-mode path (e.g. {semantic.light.surface.button.bg-default}); Dark-mode values are applied purely through the CSS cascade in tokens.css (component custom properties reference semantic custom properties, which are redefined under a Dark selector), not through a second JSON alias tree, since DTCG aliases resolve to one literal path.

transparent.$description: Figma primitive color/gray/transparent. Alpha channel restored to 00 — the CSV export dropped it; verified against the Figma API (get_variable_defs) which returned #ffffff00.
